text: Hive Workshop is a Warcraft III community site that is mainly focused on custom games, programming, modding, and art.
Hir'eek Guardians are blood trolls located in Zalamar in Nazmir.
Hir'eek Spawnling is a bat caught by Jo'chunga in Hir'eek's Lair in Nazmir. It is used by the Horde adventurer to get of the cave.
Hillstalker Worgs are worgs located in Hrydshal in Stormheim.
__NOTOC__ Hired Caravan Guardians are vulpera fighting the 7th Legion soldiers in Bonetrail Gulch in Vol'dun during the Faction Assaults.
__NOTOC__ Hivelord Vix'ick is a mantid located in Un'gol Ruins.
__NOTOC__ Hoarder Moarrgl is a murloc located in Bloodfin Village in Nazjatar.
Historian Ma'di is a jungle troll located in the Caverns of Time.
Hired Scoundrels are goblins accompanying Trade Prince Gallywix in Hobart Grapplehammer's workshop in Crapopolis. They also appear accompanying Jastor in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market.
Historian Kristi is a draenei located in the Caverns of Time.
Hivetrap Broodlings are spiders located in Stormsong Valley.
Hivetrap Broodqueens are spiders located in Stormsong Valley.
Hivemaster Nazzex is an aqir located at the Temple of Uldum in Uldum.
Hippo is a riverbeast located in Bizmo's Brawlpub and Brawl'gar Arena as part of the Senya encounter. The beast carries Senya, Doug, and Tanner.
__NOTOC__ Hissing Chitterspines are spider crabs found in Nazjatar.
Hjalmar the Undying is a vrykul ghost located at the Darkmaul Bridge on Exile's Reach. His skeleton can be found at the side of the road by the western end of the bridge.
Hobbyist Aquarist is a pet battle achievement earned by defeating 15 Master Tamers on Kul Tiras or Zandalar with a team of all level 25 Aquatic pets.
__NOTOC__ Hive-Guard Naz'ruzek is a mantid located in the Setting Sun Garrison in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

Hipokos is a steward from the Temple of Courage who was taken captive by the House of Constructs and brought to their stronghold in Maldraxxus—where he was rendered mute by having his tongue torn out—before being freed by Maw Walkers. He is currently the apprentice of Mikanikos.
Hippogryph Whistle is provided for Hope Prevails. Using it summons an Argent Hippogryph.
Hive'Ashi Prisoners were night elves located in Hive'Ashi in Silithus.
Hips is a dredger located in Sinfall in Revendreth. He is also seen in the Broker's Den in Oribos during Report to Oribos.
The Historical Treatise is looted from Dusty Books in the Ember Ward in Revendreth. The book can be handed in to Lord Scowl in return for access to the Secret Treasure.
Hocking's Plot is a farm located in within Corlain, in northwestern Drustvar. The property is owned by Harris Hocking, whose crops are being devoured by Scavenging Boars.

Hillsbrad Citizens are humans located in Southshore in Old Hillsbrad Foothills. Most of them are seen standing in place throughout the town—both inside and outside the buildings—and conversing with each other.
Hol'bruk's Brutal Brew drops from Hol'bruk the Brewcrusher at Highmaul in .
Hips' Spare Fedora drops from Zo'gron in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market.
The Hog's End Butchery is a building found in Carver's Harbor in Drustvar.

Hoarder of Torghast is awarded to players who uses certain items during Fangcrack's Fan Club in the Venthyr Assault on the Tremaculum. This achievement is one criterion of many for the On the Offensive (achievement) meta-achievement.
__NOTOC__ Hivax is a spider located in the southeastern corner of Maldraxxus, along with Boneweave Ambushers.
Hiveswarm Bracers drop from Tred'ova in Mists of Tirna Scithe.
A Hired Stealthblade appears when you approach Watcher Emil's location in the Catacombs of Regret in Revendreth during Watcher Emil (quest).
Hoard-Keeper's Key drops from Lu-Shero in the Swollen Vault on the Isle of Thunder. It is used to open the Stormy Chest.
Hoarfrost Immunity would have been crafted through Soul Cyphering.
Hirukon's Syrupy Squeezers drop from Hirukon in the Dimensional Falls in Zereth Mortis.
__NOTOC__ Hirukon is an aurelid located in the Dimensional Falls in Zereth Mortis. He is summoned by using Aurelid Lure.
Hirukon's Radiant Reach drops from Hirukon in the Dimensional Falls in Zereth Mortis.
Hipponius is an Ascended kyrian located in Haven in Zereth Mortis for players in the Kyrian Covenant.
Hired Muscles are brokers located in the Sepulcher of the First Ones.
__NOTOC__ The Hissing Grotto is a dive bar located in the north-western Waking Shores. The waters below are called the Bubble Bath.
__NOTOC__ Hivelord Karixx is a silithid reaver projection that appears at the Inventor's Library in the Storm Peaks during Telemetry Online.
Hoard of Draconic Delicacies is a great feast created with Dragon Isles Cooking (50); taught by Recipe: Hoard of Draconic Delicacies.
Historian Jum'Flitmo is a Zandalari troll located at the Temporal Conflux in Thaldraszus. He is holding a lecture for a few Timewalker Historians. He is found dead in the Primalist Future.
__NOTOC__ Hoary Icicles are ice elementals located in the Primalist Future.

Hochenblume is the most common herb found across the Dragon Isles. It can be found in practically any terrain, growing wherever possible. It can spawn rarely in 4 variants: Frigid, Lush, Titan-Touched, and Windswept. There are also Decayed Hochenblumes.
Hissing Springsouls are water elementals located at the Roaring Dragonsprings in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
__NOTOC__ The Hissing Deathroach is a maw roach companion that drops from Dark Ascended Corrus, Decayspeaker, and Elder Longbranch in the Coldheart Interstitia wing of Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

The Hoard of Shimmermaw is a small cave in the Hornswog Grounds of eastern Forbidden Reach. Named for Shimmermaw, the cave is now occupied by Mad-Eye Carrey, First Mate Ovdah, and Navigator Bi-Yun of the Irontide Raiders, with Shimmermaw Jr. looking on.

History Heist concludes the skill 75 portion of the Winterpelt Furbolg storyline. The next chapter starts at skill 100 with Words of the Winterpelt.
Hired Kithguards are drogbar located in Loamm in Zaralek Cavern.
__NOTOC__ Hoarder of the Forbidden Reach is an exploration achievement earned by opening 100 small treasures around the post-storm Forbidden Reach.
Hissing Rune Draft is located by a large, purple plant at Fanged Pasture in Zaralek Cavern. Only scribes with 25 points in Dragon Isles inscription may interact with it.
Hoarded Debris are found in a worg cave directly west of Morgan's Vigil in the Burning Steppes. The debris contain the belongings of Reginald Windsor.
Hir'eek Hide Cuffs are sold by Provisioner Lija in Nazmir for .
Hiro Brew would seemingly have been provided for monks, while having Hiro as active follower.
HoT may refer to: * Heal over time * Hour of Twilight * Hour of Twilight (instance)
Holy Nova is a Holy priest class talent which damages enemies and heals allies in a point-blank area of effect.

The most tried-and-true way to build an ideal group consists of the following Holy Trinity: *Tank(s) to take the damage (Warrior, Druid, Paladin and Death Knight.) *Healer(s) to keep party members alive (Priest, Druid, Shaman and Paladin.) *Damage dealers to deal most of the damage (Mage, Warlock, Hunter and Rogue are pure damage dealers but all classes can be damage dealers as well with the right spec and gear.) Having each of them covered is not the only way to survive, but many people will initially try to build such a group when setting out for instance runs at high levels.

:With all the warmth and flavor imbued by these spices, an ordinary dish gets a little boost of holiday cheer for the Feast of Winter Veil. You'll need these spices to whip up Greatfather Winter's favorite treats for his yearly-visit. Holiday Spices are a cooking ingredient used in several Feast of Winter Veil recipes.
Holia Sunshield has a large statue erected in her honor in the Hall of Champions, located in the Scarlet Monastery in the Tirisfal Glades. She died while slaying the dreadlord Beltheris.

Now nearly a thing of the past, HK Farmers were especially prevalent in the days between the release of the Honor System and the Battlegrounds, two months later. By definition, an HK farmer is a moderate-to-high level PvP player who repeatedly assaults lower-level settlements, in a hope of drawing out players to kill. This in turn gives them Honor Kills, which, ostensibly, bumps their PvP Rank upward. In the past, it had been the location for many great battles between the Horde and its enemies. The orcs stationed here, including peons tasked with repairing the buildings, were very much conscious of the outpost's illustrious, if short, history, though recently they had been beset by attacks mounted by the Kolkar centaur.
__NOTOC__ Holiday Spirits are an alcoholic beverage available during the Feast of Winter Veil seasonal event.
A Holy Mightstone is a former scourgestone that had its evil purged and turned against itself. It is a quest reward from the paladin quest Forging the Mightstone.

:For the post-4.0.1 version of Honor points, see Honor Points. For the original, pre-2.0, version of the honor system, see Honor system (pre-2.0). Honor point refers to points awarded by competing against enemy faction players that can be turned in for honor rewards, first introduced in Patch 2.0.1. There are several sources of Honor: * Honorable Kills * Killing racial leaders (faction bosses) * Achieving Battleground or World PvP objectives * Being nearby/in combat with a raid member doing any of the above activities will also net you honor points. * Turning in Silithyst to your faction's camp in Silithus successfully rewards you 20 Honor points. This is one of the few methods to attain hon

Holy Dust is obtained by handing in a Fel Armament to Ishanah in the Shrine of Unending Light. It is used as currency for the purchase of various shoulder enchant inscription items from Inscriber Saalyn in the Aldor Bank.
Honor is a currency rewarded for participating in PvP encounters in the form of battlegrounds, arenas and honorable kills. The cap for Honor Points is 15,000.
The Honor Hold Tabard is a mark of honor amongst the Honor Hold faction and is only available to Honor Hold's most trusted allies.
Honor Hold Mine is a mine located underneath Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula. It is occupied by gan'arg miners.

Honor's Call is an one-handed sword purchasable by Alliance players with Honor Hold from Logistics Officer Ulrike in Honor Hold on Hellfire Peninsula. The Horde equivalent of this item is Warbringer (axe).
Honor Guard Wesilow is a human quest giver located in the tower outside Honor Hold Mine in the Hellfire Peninsula.
Hollowfang Blade drops from Black Widows in Duskwood. It drops from Pygmy Venom Web Spiders in Duskwood.

The Homonculi of Karazhan are described as "demons with cool names". Homunculi in general are a type of lifelike undead construct. Kirin Tor doctrine frowns upon making homunculi, but some understand the principles involved in creating them, one of them being Khadgar. They provide 3 reputation with the Violet Eye when killed. Within Return to Karazhan few can be spotted upside down at Guardian's Library.
Honor Hold Favor is sold by in Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula for .
Holy Healing Band is a quest reward from Heart of Rage (quest) and Heart of Rage (BC Classic).

Honed Voidaxe is one of 6 rewards from the end of the Ring of Blood quest chain The Ring of Blood: The Final Challenge, after killing the last opponent, Mogor. It is a very good Arms Warrior weapon with high DPS. speed comparable to Hellreaver, and high maximum damage.
Hollow Vulture Bones drop from vultures in the Shimmering Flats in Thousand Needles: *Salt Flats Scavengers (level 30-32) *Salt Flats Vultures (level 32-34)
Holy Candles were used for a Priest's rank 1 Prayer of Fortitude.
The Holy Spring Water is obtained from The Holy Spring at the Nek'mani Wellspring in Stranglethorn Vale.
Hong Liu was a pandaren and one of the three most revered brewmasters alongside Chou Ling Sing and Xiang, and they had a frequent and friendly rivalry. Hong put his name on his brews.
The Holy War Sword drops from level 63-63 mobs in Molten Core, Blackwing Lair, Temple of Ahn'Qiraj and the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj.
Honeyed Holiday Ham is a meat food item, available during the Feast of Winter Veil. It must be used within two days of purchase, a rather short duration for a vended food item.

To obtain the Hollowed Bone Decanter you must use an Amani Hex Stick on a Forest Frog in Zul'Aman. Occasionally, the frog will turn into an NPC called Kyren, whom you can buy this item from. The item itself may contain one of the following potions:

Honor's Tomb is the last area of the Scarlet Monastery's graveyard wing. It lies at the end of the Forlorn Cloister, and is full of restless wraiths and zombies. In the lowest level of the tomb, Bloodmage Thalnos awaits the foolhardy living...
:Shaped like the hives of the wild bees domesticated in Eversong Woods, this blood elven bread does not disappoint. Enjoy it with jam or more honey - because you can't have too much honey.
Holdout Technicians are level 27-28 elite gnomes that can be found in the Gnomeregan instance.
Holdout Warriors are level 27-28 elite gnomes that can be found in the Gnomeregan instance.
The Holy Coffer can be found on a tower near Hearthglen in Western Plaguelands.

A holiday is a special day reserved to honor some notable figure or event. It can also to refer to a series of days. Many events in World of Warcraft celebrate various holidays mostly based on those celebrated in Azeroth, but trappings of these holidays can also appear in Outland. Cities are filled with Revelers during that time to point to the main area of the holiday. ;See also * Holidays category * Battleground Holidays

Hollee was one of the NPCs that could spawn by using an Amani Hex Stick on one of the wandering Forest Frogs within the old version of Zul'Aman. Once spawned, she would walk to the entrance of the instance and cheer players on when they walked by.

A Homemade Bread is a token gift item given out by Stormwind non-guard NPCs during the Love is in the Air seasonal event. These are combined into packages which are in turn hierarchically combined with other pledge packages for buffs and rewards. All of the Love is in the Air token gifts are non-functional as regards their name and picture. Homemade Bread is not a functional food item. __NOTOC__
The Hollowed Out Tree is located just north of Odesyus' Landing in Azuremyst Isle.
The Holly Preserver is located in the major cities during the Winter Veil event.

The Holding Pens are located in Razorfen Downs. The five gates hold in prisoners held by the Quilboar. Those prisoners are: * , who starts an escort quest. * , who teaches you how to make . * , who just thanks you.
The Holy Spring is located at the Nek'mani Wellspring in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
Holiday Cheesewheel is a cheese food item, available during the Feast of Winter Veil.

Hong's throat-burner attaches to the head or to a helmet. A pandaren traveler and fan of Hong Liu's famous brews developed this device to assist in case when she couldn’t ﬁnd the appropriate beverages.
Homesteader's Pack Mules are lightgray, slategray and black colored Pack Mules located at the Fort Wildevar, the most northern outpost in Howling Fjord.
__NOTOC__ Holistic Patchwork Breeches drop from Ingvar the Plunderer in Utgarde Keep normal mode.
Hollow Geode Helm drops from Krystallus in the Halls of Stone on normal mode.
__NOTOC__ Honed Cobalt Cleaver is crafted with Blacksmithing (390); taught by trainers.
Home Alone is an achievement related to the seasonal world event Children's Week. Completing this achievement is part of the meta achievement For the Children.

:This tea bursts with minty flavor and just a touch of natural sweetness from the honey. Served warm, it's a popular drink in the cold weather of Northrend; chilled, it proves a refreshing way to beat the heat of summer.
Honor Hold Cavalrymen are level 60 humans that can be found patrolling Honor Hold in the Hellfire Peninsula.

Holiday Bromance is related to the seasonal world event, the Feast of Winter Veil. Completing this achievement is a criterium for the meta achievement Merrymaker. The required Mistletoe can be obtained by kissing Winter Revelers in inns.
__NOTOC__ Hollowed Mandible Legplates drop from Hadronox in Azjol-Nerub on heroic mode.
A Holiday Fireworks Vendor is an NPC fireworks vendor that sells fireworks during the Midsummer Fire Festival or Peon Day seasonal events (see Notes section.)

This is one of the Children's Week quests where you escort the Frenzyheart Wolvar orphan Kekek. All three of Playmates!, The Bronze Dragonshrine and Home Of The Bear-Men must be completed to progress to the next pair of quests.
Honor Guard Greyn is located on a bed in the Honor Hold Inn in Hellfire Peninsula.
The Honed Fang of the Mystics drops from Onyxia in the 25-man version of Onyxia's Lair.
Holy Water is provided as an objective for The Restless Dead.
Honor of the Fallen can be found inside the Tribute Chest after defeating Anub'arak in the 10-man version of Trial of the Grand Crusader.
Holistic Herbalism is a herbalism shop found on the middle rise of Thunder Bluff.

Holographic Projector is a quest item for A Disarming Distraction. The projector, when dropped, has a chance of displaying one of the three options: ;The , , combination: : : : : ;An epic running mechanostrider in a blue paint job: : : : : ;A dancing female eredar using the succubus sounds... : : : :
Holland's Findings was provided by Junior Apothecary Holland for Delivery to Silverpine Forest (2).

This sheath straps to the forearms and is usually worn beneath the sleeves of a loose tunic. A controlled twitch of the muscles releases a catch, and springs inside the sheath to push a dagger out into the wearer's hand. The dagger has a chance of being jammed in the sheath.
Homecoming Wrap is a quest reward for The Battle of Darrowshire (quest).
Honor's Stand Guards are human guards found in and around Honor's Stand in the Southern Barrens. Some of them will combat the forces of nearby Hunter's Hill.
Holy Flame Gauntlets are created with Blacksmithing (525); taught by Plans: Holy Flame Gauntlets.

The Holy Thurible is provided as an objective for Those That Couldn't Let Go. When used on a Withdrawn Soul, a holy ball will shoot towards the target. The souls will then either pass on or turn hostile.
Honeykeepers are wasps located at the Arboretum in the Jade Forest.

Honeydew Village is a pandaren village in northwestern Jade Forest. The village is made up of brewers and farmers, run by the Honeydews, however, the real heart of the village is the brewery, which is run by the Honeypaws. They make the best Honeybrew anywhere. The village's usual calm was first disturbed by the Alliance troops, who set up camp in the nearby Thunder Hold and recruited some volunteers to build the Strongarm Airstrip, and later when the Horde gunship Hellscream's Fist reached the land too: in the ensuing battle (that ended with the Alliance forces eradicated and the Horde gunship crashed behind the village) the farms of the village were accidentaly bombarded and some barrels o
Hong the Kindly is a pandaren stable master located a few steps east of The Drunken Hozen, the inn of the town of Dawn's Blossom in the Jade Forest.

Honeydew Glade is the lightly wooded area between Honeydew Village and Thunder Hold in the Jade Forest. It is bordered by Spiritsong River to the north and turns slowly upward past Mogu ruins into Ascent of Swirling Winds to the south. An ancient road through the center of the glade leads from Honeydew Village to a small pagoda at the glade's southeastern edge. Normally inhabited by Wary Forest Prowlers, the presence of the sha due to the Horde and Alliance confict has spread to the local tigers, transforming them into aggressive Sha-Infested Prowlers. During its entry into Pandaria, the Horde gunship Hellscream's Fist was stuck over the glade and forced to confront the Alliance troops in ne

Honeydew Farm is a small farm just north of Honeydew Village in the Jade Forest. Due to the recent fire fight between the Horde and the Alliance, the farm has caught fire and is burning to the ground as field workers are too terrified to put out the fires. The farm used the Spiritsong River as its source of water.
The Honeydews are a family of pandaren that control the Honeydew Village, which is located in the Jade Forest. They have guarded this town for generations.
The Honeypaws are a family of pandaren that own the brewery at Honeydew Village, which is located in the Jade Forest. They are well-known for their Honeybrew, a sweet brew made from melons and honey.

Honeycatcher Lang is a pandaren residing in a small house in the southwestern part of the Arboretum in the Jade Forest. He can be found walking around the courtyard, continuously sitting down to drink or eat. He has a mule companion, Ayor.
Holy Censer is provided as an objective for Soothing Spirits.
Honeydew Village Guards is a pandaren at Honeydew Village in the Jade Forest.
Hong Airsquat is a pandaren located at Warspear Outpost in Ashran.
The Hollowblood Scarf is an level cloak that gives a bonus to Intellect and Stamina.
The Hollowblood Cloak is a quest reward from Servants of a Dead God.
Hollowheart Chain Leggings is a quest reward from Blaze of Glory.
Hollowheart Legguards is a quest reward from Blaze of Glory.
Hollowheart Pantaloons is a quest reward from Blaze of Glory.
Holly McTilla is a dwarf conquest vendor located at the Stormshield in Ashran. She looks identical to Ingrid Blackingot, who is nearby; amusingly, Ingrid wants to know where Holly gets her hair done.

Holyoak is a rare type of wood originating from the Kingdom of Stormwind. It is known to have existed at some point during the First War and it was used primarily to build Stormwind's churches. This sacred wood must be carefully cut and therefore it had to be specially prepared at a human lumber mill before a church could be built.
Holy Diadem had an extremely low chance of being looted from a Big Crate of Salvage.
Holy Enchantment is a buff given out by Light-Infused Crystals and Sun Spheres during To Be Prepared.
Holding Cell Key is pickpocketed from the Soulkeeper during the second stage of Fangs of the Devourer (quest).
Honed Instincts is a Feral druid artifact trait. It is linked to the Hardened Roots and Shadow Thrash traits.
Holy Aegis is a Protection paladin artifact trait. It is linked to the Bulwark of the Silver Hand and Defender of Truth traits.
Honor Hold Defenders are human and dwarves holding several Honor Hold installations in Hellfire Peninsula. Most of them are old now after decades of conflict. One of them is stuck in an outhouse.
Honor's Stand Gyrocopters are gyrocopters hovering above the Great Divide in order to protect the skies of Honor's Stand in the Southern Barrens.
Honor's Stand Sharpshooters are humans guarding the outskirts of Honor's Stand in the Southern Barrens.
Holy Lightspawn are lightspawn located in Primordial Observatory near the Maelstrom during the quest The Sunken Vault (quest).
__NOTOC__ Honey Encased Farmhands are humans located in the Wendigo Highlands in Stormsong Valley.
Honey Bear is a bear located in the camp of Hunter Robin in Stormsong Valley.
The Honey Vat can be found in the middle of the camp of Hunter Robin and his friends in Stormsong Valley.
Honed Jed'hin Scimitar drops from Jed'hin Champion Vorusk in Eredath.

Honor levels is the rank system part of the new Honor system in Legion. Honor levels are earned with honor points as the experience. Prior to Battle for Azeroth, every 50 Honor levels was prestiged to earn additional rewards. With patch 8.0.1, the Honor level meter and next reward can be found on the Player vs. Player interface, accessed through the Group Finder.
Holy Scrap! is a profession achievement earned for scraping 100 items at Scrap-O-Matic 1000 or Shred-Master Mk1.
Honor Level 60 is a Player vs. Player achievement earned for reaching honor level 60.
Honor's Stand Officers are humans located on the pathway between Honor's Stand and the Overgrowth in the Southern Barrens.
Honor's Stand Footmen are humans located on the pathway between Honor's Stand and the Overgrowth in the Southern Barrens.
Honey-Artisan's Ring is a quest reward from Don't Go in the Basement.
Hollowbeak Falcons are falcons located in Foxhollow Woods in Tiragarde Sound.
The Honor of the Skyhorn is a quest reward from The Witchqueen.
Honey-Crazed Maulers are wendigo located in Stormsong Valley.
Honor Hold Gryphon Riders are dwarves located in Hellfire Peninsula.
The Honey Smasher is a rare elite ettin who can be found in northern Stormsong Valley. Once per day, killing him will reward Honeyback Hive reputation and bee-related loot.
Honey Seekers are ravager wasps located in Stormsong Valley.
Honey Seeker Hivemothers are ravager wasps located in Stormsong Valley.
Honey Seeker Stingers are ravager wasps located in Stormsong Valley.
Honey Seeker Swarmers are ravager wasps located in Stormsong Valley.
Honey-Crazed Denmothers are bears located in Stormsong Valley.
Honey-Crazed Grizzlies are bears located in Stormsong Valley.
Hollowbeak Hunting Rifle is a quest reward from No Party Like a Trogg Party.

Honey-Glazed Gauntlets drop from Honey-Coated Slitherer in Tiragarde Sound.
Honey Soaked Boots are located in Mildenhall Meadery in Stormsong Valley.
Honeyback Hatchery is a beehive home belonging to the Honeyback Hive bees in Stormsong Valley.

Holy Word: Salvation is a Holy priest talent. It heals all allies within 40 yards of the caster and applies Renew and 2 stacks of Prayer of Mending to each of them. It has a very long cooldown that can be shortened by using Holy Word: Serenity and Holy Word: Sanctify. It's castable while in Spirit of Redemption form. It is an exclusive choice node with Apotheosis.
__NOTOC__ Hollowed Crystal is crafted with Shadowlands Jewelcrafting for Jewelcrafting: Carved Crystal Ring.
The Hollowed Dredbat Fang is provided as an objective for Let the Hunt Begin.
Homegrown Help becomes available after upgrading the Ember Court to rank 2.
Holy Oration is a conduit for holy priests. It drops from Devos in the Spires of Ascension and Kel'Thuzad in the Sanctum of Domination.
Honeycombs drop from Honeykeepers in the Arboretum in the Jade Forest.

The Hole in the Wall is located at in the southwest segment of the Court of the Harvesters and is accessible through a titular hole in the hall made by a biggun Crunchfoot the Clumsy through the Charred Ramparts and through an elevator from Darkwall Tower. The dredger Mims serves as innkeeper. There is a sinrunner that runs from here through the Court of the Harvesters, along the northern wall of Dominance Gate, and back to the Hole in the Wall.
The Holographic Digitalization Hearthstone is a toy created with Junkyard Tinkering.

Two Hollow Rocks can be found near the gate to the Ember Ward where Stonehead stands guard—one inside the ward and one outside. Interacting with a Hollow Rock grants for 10 minutes, disguising you as a rock and allowing you to pass through the gate without Stonehead stopping you. He'll simply remark: : Donning a Hollow Rock also allows you to reach the Chewed Light Shard next to Stonehead and pick up its quest, Snacks for Stonehead.

__NOTOC__ Hollowsoul is a Maw subjugator who guards the entrance to the Torment Chambers from Gorgoa, River of Souls in the Sanctum of Domination. They are accompanied by two soul eaters, Dreadmaw and Terrorspine.

Holy Champion is an unimplemented priest spell that was added to the database in . It resembles the earlier unused spell Proclaim Champion, though unlike Proclaim Champion, it wouldn't have enabled any additional champion spells.
Hollow of the Insolent is a cave in The Rift of the Maw, where the Forlorn Respite normally is. See the Rift article for more information on gaining access to the Rift.
Hollow Gromits are gromits located in the Gromit Hollow of Korthia. General Draven wants them taken out in his Sweep the Windswept Aerie daily quest.
Homemade Fish Fry is sold during Kosh'harg by Razgar at Razor Hill in Durotar for .
Honey Mead is found at the Forge of Odyn in Skyhold during Fury Given Voice. It is used in the process of crafting the Newly Forged Horn.

Hooking functions allows you to replace a function value in an accessible environment by a function of your own, calling the original function before or after execution of new code. Hooking enables addons to modify and/or extend the behavior of the default UI and API. Honorless Target is a buff, which was introduced in Patch 1.4, but not made visible until patch 1.41. Blizzard says (in the patch notes for patch 1.41): Honorless Target - Players who just land from a gryphon/wyvern, or step out of an instance will gain this buff for 30 seconds during which this target will give no contribution points if killed. This was originally implemented in the previous patch, but was kept invisible. It has been noticed that this buff also occurs when players have just used their Hearthstone. Additionally, this status occurs if a player's connection times out, yet does not result in the character's death.
